descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S25 Marker data never crosses contexts on any screen: lists, charts, search, dashboard, Task Export, Inbox, multi-patient Handoff

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu … (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fixture extended with distinctive marker data per context. Hospital patient: pre-round 'MARK-H-PR T21 overnight fever resolved', Important Point 'MARK-H ip T21', open task 'MARK-H task T21 follow up BMP', Quick Dictation box 'MARK-H qd T21'. …

When Visit each context's list, Pre-Round chart, search (query 'Resident' in Hospital, 'Hosp' in Nursing Home), dashboard, Task Export / task review, the Handoffs inbox and the multi-patient Handoff sheet

Then Each screen shows its own context's markers where they belong, and never the other context's markers or patient. Dashboard totals equal the context's own count (1).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs. The own-context markers on the chart and task screens are positive controls, so a run on an unseeded fixture fails instead of passing vacuously. Every screen mustNotContain the other context's marker prefix ('MARK-H' / 'MARK-N') and patient. Scope beyond lists and charts is Q5; it is tested meanwhile.

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
